name: National Fisheries Landings Program (fictional)
covers: Wild-catch species in all eight regions (dockside first-sale price and landings)
notes: Dockside first-sale price and landings volume.

name: National Aquaculture Survey (fictional)
covers: Farmed species in all eight regions (farm-gate price and harvest)

name: Coastal Seafood Association Wholesale Report (fictional)
covers: Most series; not wild salmon (Pacific Northwest), caviar (Southeast) or four other thinly covered series
notes: Wholesale price runs about 15 percent above first-sale price. Volume covers association members only.

name: Seafood Trade Weekly Price Notes (fictional)
covers: A dozen high-profile series including shrimp, lobster, cod, tuna, snapper, crab, king crab and salmon in selected regions
notes: Price quotes only, noisier than official data. No volume.

name: Team Sample Dataset (fictional)
notes: Fallback only. Always labeled as sample data. Caps confidence at low.

name: National Seafood Retail Price Survey (fictional)
covers: Most series at retail; markups vary by category (see reference/markup_table.csv)
notes: Shelf prices per pound. Retail prices move less than dockside prices. No volume.

name: Regional Dock Auction and Market Postings (fictional)
covers: Two to three markets per region; see registry/markets.csv
notes: Used for market comparison, not for the series pipeline. Each market has its own freshness.

name: Seafood Inspection and Grading Records (fictional)
covers: Quality grades and verification status per series

name: Fishery Input Cost Survey (fictional)
covers: Diesel, bait, ice, feed, labor and packaging costs for all eight regions
